title: Partition invite hygiene into canonical vertical outcomes

outcomes.statement: Pending invitations stop consuming seats indefinitely through configurable overdue alerts and safe manual or scheduled withdrawal with requester notification and a durable trail.
outcomes.demo: An overdue pending invitation alerts; authorized manual or scheduled withdrawal deletes only that invitation, frees the reservation after success, and records its action and notification.

uncertainties.statement: The canonical 2-SP estimate is 448 minutes at 224 min/SP; measured neighboring children also exceeded their optimistic estimates.
uncertainties.resolution: Use three complete vertical outcomes with measured-scope estimates of 140, 310 and 280 minutes, including preview, review and final campaign. Parent is non-executable and estimates must be recalculated against exact child plans before approval.

uncertainties.statement: Canonical child IDs and the automatic-withdraw configuration contract are not delivered.
uncertainties.resolution: This is a non-executable partition proposal. Work IDs remain null until a functional CHG creates and delivers canonical children. Nous must approve the invitation-only boundary and disabled-by-default expiry semantics before child readiness. US-019 and US-042 are already dev_done; all children must retain both canonical prerequisite IDs.

partitions.title: Surface overdue invitations with configurable alerts
partitions.outcome: Group Admins see only eligible unaccepted invitations older than the configured threshold, with one actionable invite_unaccepted alert per open breach.
partitions.demo: Evaluate invitations just below, exactly at, and above 168 hours; only the above-threshold invitation alerts, repeated evaluation deduplicates, and disabled or foreign-company rules do not alert.

partitions.title: Withdraw a pending invitation safely from exceptions
partitions.outcome: An authorized Group Admin withdraws exactly the selected pending invitation with a required note, releases its seat reservation only after provider success, and sees the durable withdrawn action in the request trail.
partitions.demo: Withdraw an overdue invitation from exceptions and verify the provider invitation deletion, invited-to-deprovisioned transition, freed reservation and note in Acciones; race with acceptance and prove no active member or assignment is removed.

uncertainties.statement: The existing generic deprovision operation may delete an active member when an invitation is accepted concurrently.
uncertainties.resolution: Add an invitation-specific vendor-neutral operation pinned to the durable provider invitation reference, with Pact-backed invitation deletion, shared action locking, post-I/O state revalidation, and fail-closed ambiguous outcomes. Never use email-based member removal for invite hygiene.

partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC2 is split by manual versus scheduled trigger. This child owns the complete manual withdrawal and shared invitation-only service; AC3 records manual withdrawals. The automatic child reuses the service and verifies its own notification and trail evidence.

partitions.title: Expire stale invitations automatically and notify the requester
partitions.outcome: The scheduled hygiene job withdraws eligible pending invitations after an explicitly enabled configurable expiry window, releases the seat reservation and re-notifies the requester exactly once with a durable action trail.
partitions.demo: Configure expiry, advance an injected clock, run the job twice and verify one invitation-only deletion, one lifecycle transition, one requester notification and one visible action; accepted, foreign-company, disabled and not-yet-due invitations remain untouched.

uncertainties.statement: Canonical sources name a configurable auto-withdraw window but do not establish its default or a validated threshold key.
uncertainties.resolution: Propose auto-withdraw disabled until an operator explicitly configures a positive window no shorter than the alert threshold. Store it with existing AlertRule thresholds; Nous must approve and emit the exact key and semantics in the partition CHG before child readiness. The allowance is included in the estimate.

partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC2 automatic withdrawal is independently observable from the manual trigger. This child verifies automatic requester notification and the AC3 automatic action trail while reusing the manual child's safe service.
